I'll compute the sum of the decimal digits of 64! to verify the provided result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)
print(f"64! = {factorial_64}")

# Convert to string to access digits
digits_str = str(factorial_64)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")

# Calculate sum of digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")

# Verify the digits
print(f"Digits: {digits_str}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Double-check the computation
import math

factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in str(factorial_64))
print(f"Final Answer: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
